detail: Scheme of Arrangement - JSW Cement Limited (the "Company") at its meeting held on September 29, 2026, has ,inter alia, subject to approval of the shareholders of the Company, considered and approved the Scheme of Arrangement between Shiva Cement Limited ( SCL  or  the Transferor Company ) and JSW Cement Limited  ( the Transferee Company  or  JCL  or  the Company ).
